apps.readme:
# ⬡ WhyAlwaysEng Hub

> **A high-performance, zero-backend personal software distribution hub and store powered 100% by GitHub Releases.**

[![CI/CD Status](https://github.com/WhyAlwaysEng/whyalwayseng-hub/actions/workflows/deploy.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/WhyAlwaysEng/whyalwayseng-hub/actions)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Built with Tailwind v4](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind_CSS-v4-38bdf8.svg)](https://tailwindcss.com)
[![Alpine.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Alpine.js-3.x-8bc0d0.svg)](https://alpinejs.dev)
[![Security Tested](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-XSS_Disarmed-emerald.svg)](scripts/test-security.mjs)
[![PWA Ready](https://img.shields.io/badge/PWA-Ready-f59e0b.svg)](src/manifest.webmanifest)

---

## 🌟 Overview

**WhyAlwaysEng Hub** is an ultra-fast, minimalist personal application distribution store. It eliminates the need for complex databases, backend servers, or paid hosting by using GitHub Repositories and GitHub Releases as the single source of truth.

- **Zero-Backend Architecture:** 100% Static Site Generation (SSG). Client browsers query cached static JSON and pre-rendered HTML without ever hitting runtime GitHub API rate limits.
- **Ultra-Minimalist Aesthetic:** Clean monochrome typography inspired by Linear, Raycast, and Vercel with flawless class-based Dark & Light mode toggle.
- **Smart OS & Architecture Detection:** Automatically detects whether visitors are on Windows, macOS, or Linux (x64 / arm64) and highlights the direct 1-click installer download.
- **Uniform Media Gallery:** Displays 16:9 aspect-ratio screenshots and demonstration videos with an expandable full-screen Lightbox modal (`Esc` to close).
- **Admin Command Center (`/admin`):** Integrated web dashboard to inspect, import, and delete software with live preview cards.
- **GitHub PAT Security Gate:** In production, the `/admin` dashboard is locked by a GitHub Personal Access Token gate, ensuring only you can manage your applications.
- **Automated Cloud Sync (GitHub Actions):** Runs every midnight UTC to fetch the latest releases, download counts, and commit hashes without you having to leave your computer on.

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack & Architecture

- **Core Framework:** Vanilla JavaScript (ES Modules) + [Alpine.js](https://alpinejs.dev) for lightweight reactive states.
- **Styling:** [Tailwind CSS v4](https://tailwindcss.com) with `@variant dark` class toggle and custom typography.
- **Search Engine:** Client-side fuzzy keyword search powered by [Fuse.js](https://www.fusejs.io).
- **Markdown & Release Notes:** [marked.js](https://marked.js.org) + [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) for 100% XSS-safe rendering.
- **Schema Validation:** Strict JSON Schema validation using [Ajv](https://ajv.js.org).
- **Hosting & CI/CD:** GitHub Pages + GitHub Actions.

---

## 📁 Repository Structure

```
whyalwayseng-hub/
├── .github/
│   └── workflows/
│       └── deploy.yml          # Automated daily build & GitHub Pages deploy
├── data/
│   └── catalog.json            # Compiled catalog snapshot with releases
├── locales/
│   ├── en.json                 # English localization strings
│   └── th.json                 # Thai localization strings
├── schema/
│   └── projects.schema.json    # JSON Schema definition for projects.json
├── scripts/
│   ├── build-catalog.mjs       # Scrapes GitHub API and compiles catalog
│   ├── build-site.mjs          # SSG generator for pages, sitemap & RSS feed
│   ├── dev-server.mjs          # Local dev server with Admin REST API
│   ├── manage-apps.mjs         # CLI tool for 1-click app additions/removals
│   ├── test-security.mjs       # Automated XSS & regex unit test suite
│   └── validate.mjs            # Ajv schema validator
├── src/
│   ├── admin.html              # Store Admin Command Center
│   ├── app.js                  # Client Alpine.js logic & stores
│   ├── favicon.svg             # Vector brand icon matching navbar
│   ├── manifest.webmanifest    # PWA install manifest
│   ├── styles.css              # Tailwind CSS v4 root stylesheet
│   └── sw.js                   # Service Worker for offline capability
├── projects.json               # Config of active applications in store
└── projects.example.json       # Backup reference list of top open-source tools
```

---

## ⚡ Quick Start (Local Development)

### Prerequisites
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) v20.x or v22.x+
- npm v10+

### Installation & Setup

1. **Clone the repository:**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/whyalwayseng-hub.git
   cd whyalwayseng-hub
   ```

2. **Install dependencies:**
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

3. **Start local development server:**
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```
   - Storefront: [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)
   - Admin Command Center: [http://localhost:3000/admin](http://localhost:3000/admin)

4. **Run automated security & quality tests:**
   ```bash
   npm test
   ```

5. **Build for production:**
   ```bash
   npm run build
   ```

---

## 📦 Managing Software in Your Store

### Option 1: Via CLI (Fastest)

- **Add an application:**
  ```bash
  npm run app:add <owner>/<repo>
  # Example:
  npm run app:add WhyAlwaysEng/my-desktop-tool
  ```
  The script automatically inspects the repo, detects `.exe`, `.msi`, `.dmg`, or `.deb` assets, generates regex rules, and writes to `projects.json`.

- **Remove an application:**
  ```bash
  npm run app:remove <slug>
  # Example:
  npm run app:remove github-cli
  ```

---

### Option 2: Via Admin Web Dashboard

1. Launch dev server: `npm run dev`
2. Open [http://localhost:3000/admin](http://localhost:3000/admin)
3. Paste any GitHub repository URL into the **Import Software** box.
4. Click **Analyze** to review the live bento preview card, edit categories, and select platforms.
5. Click **Save to Store** — changes are instantly saved to `projects.json`!
6. Click **⚡ Rebuild** to refresh the static HTML pages.

---

## 🚀 Production Deployment (GitHub Pages)

### 1. Push Code to GitHub
```bash
git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-username>/whyalwayseng-hub.git
git branch -M master
git push -u origin master
```

### 2. Enable GitHub Pages
1. On GitHub, navigate to **Settings** > **Pages**.
2. Under **Build and deployment > Source**, select **`GitHub Actions`**.
3. Under **Settings** > **Actions** > **General** > **Workflow permissions**, choose **`Read and write permissions`** (so the GitHub Actions bot can update release statistics).

### 3. All Done!
Within 1-2 minutes, your store will be live at:
`https://<your-username>.github.io/<your-repo-name>/`

---

## 🔒 Security & Quality Assurance

- **Strict Content Security Policy (CSP):** All inline scripts, unsafe connections, and untrusted frames are disarmed.
- **Automated XSS Prevention:** Release changelogs and README markdown are passed through a double-pass pipeline: `marked` parsing followed by aggressive sanitization via `DOMPurify`.
- **Verified Regex Rule Sets:** Prevents regex overlap bugs (e.g., ensuring `darwin` is never falsely categorized as `windows`).

---

# ZeroCast v1.0 ### **Ultra-Low Latency Native Android Screen & Audio Mirroring Engine** *High-Performance GPU H.264 Acceleration • Studio PCM Internal Audio • Virtual Camera (OBS/Discord) • Reverse Control* [![Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/Release-v1.0.0-00E676?style=for-the-badge&logo=android)](https://github.com/WhyAlwaysEng/ZeroCast/releases) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Android%20%7C%20Windows-38BDF8?style=for-the-badge&logo=windows)](https://github.com/WhyAlwaysEng/ZeroCast) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blueviolet?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10%2B-3776AB?style=for-the-badge&logo=python)](https://python.org) [![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-1.9%2B-7F52FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=kotlin)](https://kotlinlang.org)
--- ## 🌟 Highlights & Key Features ZeroCast is an open-source, ultra-low latency screen mirroring and internal audio streaming ecosystem built specifically for gaming, content creation, presentations, and device management over local Wi-Fi or USB cable. - ⚡ **Zero-Latency H.264 GPU Pipeline**: Hardware-accelerated encoding directly from Android `MediaCodec` into PyAV C-level decoding with baseline profile (no B-frames) for instantaneous responsiveness. - 📱 **100% Native Display Resolution**: Supports high-density physical resolutions (e.g. 1080×2400 FHD+) with dynamic orientation auto-switching (Landscape ⇄ Portrait). - 🔊 **Internal Audio Capture (`AudioPlaybackCapture`)**: Streams system audio and game audio directly into PC speakers with dedicated ~200ms Jitter Buffer and zero crackle. - 🎧 **Dynamic Audio Output Selector**: Easily route mobile audio between your Gaming Headset (HyperX, etc.) and Speakers directly from the PC receiver. - 🎥 **Virtual Camera Integration**: Turn your mobile device (screen or camera) into an ultra-sharp 1080p 60FPS webcam for **Discord, Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and OBS Studio**. - 🖱️ **Full Reverse Touch & Keyboard Injection**: Click, drag, and swipe the phone from your PC screen with automatic ADB tunneling. Type directly using your physical PC keyboard. - 📊 **Floating Mobile Performance HUD**: Drag-and-drop floating pill displaying live CPU %, RAM %, and Battery Temp on your phone, with tap-to-shrink Ghost Mode (completely invisible on PC). - 🌙 **Auto-Dim Screen Saver**: Dims phone backlight to 1% while streaming to eliminate heat and save 40–50% battery, while the PC mirror stays 100% vibrant. - 🚀 **Built-in GitHub Auto-Update Checker**: Both PC receiver and mobile client automatically detect new GitHub releases and provide one-click updates. --- ## 🏗️ Architecture Overview ```mermaid graph LR subgraph Android["📱 Android Client (Kotlin)"] A[MediaProjection] --> B[MediaCodec H.264 GPU] C[AudioPlaybackCapture] --> D[PCM 16-bit 48kHz] B --> E[TCP Frame Streamer] D --> E F[Dynamic ABR Engine] -.->|Adjust Bitrate| B end subgraph Transport["⚡ Transport Layer"] E -->|USB ADB Reverse / Wi-Fi LAN| G[Port 8888 TCP] H[UDP Discovery Beacon] -.->|Port 8889| I[Auto-Discovery] end subgraph PC["🖥️ Windows PC Receiver (PyQt6 / PyAV)"] G --> J[PyAV H.264 Hardware Decoder] G --> K[Asynchronous Jitter Buffer] J --> L[Glassmorphic Canvas Viewport] J --> M[🎥 OBS Virtual Camera] K --> N[🎧 QAudioSink Output Device] O[Mouse & Keyboard Controller] -->|ADB Shell Input| A end ``` --- ## 📂 Repository Structure This repository is modularly split into two independent sub-projects: | Component | Path | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **🖥️ PC Receiver** | [`pc_receiver/`](pc_receiver/) | Python PyQt6 desktop receiver, hardware decoder, audio sink, and virtual camera engine. | | **📱 Android Client** | [`android_client/`](android_client/) | Native Android app in Kotlin utilizing MediaProjection, MediaCodec, and Foreground Services. | | **🎨 Assets** | [`assets/`](assets/) | Vector logos, app icons, and branding graphics. | 👉 For dedicated setup and development guides, visit: - **[PC Receiver Guide & Setup (pc_receiver/README.md)](pc_receiver/README.md)** - **[Android Client Guide & Build (android_client/README.md)](android_client/README.md)** --- ## 🚀 Quick Start Guide ### 1. Launch PC Receiver Make sure you have Python 3.10+ installed: ```powershell # Navigate to pc_receiver directory cd pc_receiver # Install dependencies pip install -r requirements.txt # Start receiver python main.py ``` ### 2. Connect from Android 1. Open the **ZeroCast** app on your phone. 2. Select your connection mode: - **⚡ USB Cable**: Plug in USB cable with USB Debugging enabled. The app auto-connects to `127.0.0.1:8888`. - **📡 Wi-Fi**: Tap **`[ 🔍 Auto-Discover PC ]`** to automatically find your computer on LAN. 3. Tap **`▶ START STREAMING (H.264)`**. 4. Enjoy smooth, zero-latency mirroring on your PC! --- ## ⌨️ PC Keyboard & Mouse Shortcuts | Action / Shortcut | Function | | :--- | :--- | | **Left Click & Drag** | Simulates touch tap and swipe on the Android device | | **F11 / Double Click** | Toggle Fullscreen Mode | | **Esc** | Exit Fullscreen / Send Android Back Key | | **PC Typing** | Directly inputs text, letters, space, backspace, and enter to Android | | **`🎥 V-Cam` Button** | Activates Virtual Camera feed for Discord, Zoom, OBS | | **`📌 Pin` Button** | Pins the ZeroCast window always on top | --- ## 📜 License ZeroCast is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
